supporting_objects.name: VARIANT
FIFO_CopyBytes

inputs.name: enqueue
inputs.description: Enqueue request; one operation per rising edge.

inputs.name: dequeue
inputs.description: Dequeue request; one operation per rising edge.

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: TRUE resets the queue to empty; takes priority over enqueue and dequeue.

outputs.name: elementCount
outputs.description: Current number of valid elements, from zero through the queue capacity.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Invocation status: 16#0000 no error, 16#8001 dequeue from an empty queue, 16#8002 enqueue into a full queue.
